company.name: Quary
company.description: Operator of a data infrastructure platform intended for developers seeking efficient data management solutions. The company offers a unified interface to streamline database workflows and version control with features like collaborative querying, schema tracking, and automated documentation, enabling software development teams to enhance productivity, ensure data integrity, and facilitate seamless collaboration in creating robust applications across various industries and projects.

productsAndServices.description: A Rust-powered, browser-based platform for building and iterating on data workflows, dashboards, and reports without server dependency or database changes.
productsAndServices.name: Quary Data Transformation Platform
